info.name: CarStore Platform API — SuperAdmin
info.description:
Endpoints for the SuperAdmin panel (saas-super-admin change).
Requires a JWT issued for a SuperAdmin user (role=SuperAdmin, platform_role=super_admin).

## Pre-requisite: seed a SuperAdmin user

Run the following SQL against your Postgres database before using this collection:

```sql
-- Step 1: insert the SuperAdmin user
INSERT INTO users (id, email, password_hash, role, dealer_id, is_active, created_at)
VALUES (
  gen_random_uuid(),
  'ops@carstore.io',
  '<bcrypt-hash-of-your-password>',
  'SuperAdmin',
  '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',
  true,
  NOW()
) RETURNING id;

-- Step 2: grant all platform permissions (replace <user-id> with the id from step 1)
INSERT INTO user_permissions (user_id, permission)
SELECT '<user-id>', unnest(ARRAY[
  'platform:dealers:read',
  'platform:dealers:suspend',
  'platform:dealers:activate',
  'platform:metrics:read'
]);
```

Or use the application seeder (ops@carstore.io / Ops123! for dev environments).

## Authentication
1. Run 'P0 Login as SuperAdmin' first.
2. The token is saved in the 'platformToken' variable automatically.
3. All other requests use that token via Bearer auth.

## ETag / concurrency
Suspend and Activate send the `eTag` field in the request body (NOT as an HTTP If-Match header).
The `eTag` value comes from the `eTag` field in the GET /dealers response.
On a 412 response, re-run GET /dealers to refresh the ETag before retrying.

item.name: P0 Login as SuperAdmin
item.description: Log in as the seeded SuperAdmin user. Saves the JWT to 'platformToken'.

item.name: P1 GET /api/platform/dealers

exec: // Save first dealer id + eTag for subsequent requests

item.description:
Returns all dealers across all tenants, ordered by createdAt desc.
Requires permission: platform:dealers:read.

The response includes an 'eTag' field per dealer (xmin row version).
Save it before calling suspend/activate.

item.name: P2 POST /api/platform/dealers/{id}/suspend

exec: console.warn('412 Precondition Failed — ETag is stale. Re-run P1 to refresh dealerETag.');

item.description:
Soft-suspends a dealer. Sets IsActive=false.
Requires permission: platform:dealers:suspend.

Body fields:
- reason (string, required, max 500 chars)
- eTag (string, required) — from the 'eTag' field in GET /dealers response

Errors:
- 400: empty reason
- 404: dealer not found
- 412: ETag mismatch (stale — re-GET dealers to refresh)

item.name: P3 POST /api/platform/dealers/{id}/activate

exec: console.warn('412 Precondition Failed — ETag is stale. Re-run P1 to refresh dealerETag.');

item.description:
Reactivates a suspended dealer. Idempotent — already-active returns 200.
Requires permission: platform:dealers:activate.

Body fields:
- eTag (string, required) — from the 'eTag' field in GET /dealers response

Errors:
- 404: dealer not found
- 412: ETag mismatch (stale — re-GET dealers to refresh)

item.name: P4 GET /api/platform/metrics
item.description:
Returns aggregated platform metrics.
Requires permission: platform:metrics:read.

Note: mrr.isStub is always true until saas-subscription-payments is implemented.
mrr.stubReason contains the grep-findable string 'Requires saas-subscription-payments'.
